what: Restaurant Brands International owns Burger King, Tim Hortons, Popeyes and Firehouse Subs: over 33,000 restaurants in more than 120 countries, more than 95% of them franchised.
customers: Franchisees who operate the restaurants, and through them fast-food customers worldwide.
money: Canadian coffee and food, where it is dominant
the global burger chain, strongest outside the US
franchise royalties outside the US and Canada
moat: Tim Hortons' position in Canada, where it is part of daily routine for a large share of the country, plus global brand recognition for Burger King.
risks: Debt of about $15 billion against under $1 billion of cash
Burger King's US restaurants have lagged McDonald's for years and need remodelling
Franchisee profitability limits how fast new restaurants open
Geopolitical boycotts have hurt sales in some markets
opportunities: Revenue grew about 12% last year with a 23% operating margin
A multi-year programme to remodel US Burger King restaurants is under way
watch: Comparable sales at Burger King US and Tim Hortons Canada.
